basic_information.official_title: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR THE BANGSAMORO ADMINISTRATIVE CODE

citizen_summary.what_is_this_about: Provides for the Bangsamoro Administrative Code.
citizen_summary.why_was_it_proposed: Foundational 'constitution-in-practice' of the regional bureaucracy; most-amended BAA (BAA 37, 93/94, plus multiple pending bills).
citizen_summary.what_will_change: Provides for the Bangsamoro Administrative Code.
citizen_summary.when_will_it_take_effect: Ratified 2020-10-28; effectivity per the Act's final section (typically 15 days after Official Gazette publication).

what_this_means_for_you.in_short: The Administrative Code is the operating manual of the Bangsamoro Government: it defines every ministry and office, their powers, and how they must deal with you. Whenever you transact with any BARMM office - permits, IDs, complaints, appeals - this law is the rulebook behind the counter.
in_practice: Names the ministries and what each is responsible for, so you know which door to knock on
Sets the chain of authority - who can decide, who can be appealed to
Later laws keep amending it (seat of government, SGA authority), so always check the current consolidated text

for_specific_groups.Anyone transacting with government: Defines your right to be served by a designated, accountable office
for_specific_groups.Civil-society & researchers: The map of the whole bureaucracy in one law
for_specific_groups.Local officials: Defines how BARMM relates to provinces, cities, and municipalities

what_this_means_for_you.where_this_applies: All of BARMM unless the title names a specific place
what_this_means_for_you.when_you_will_feel_it: Laws take effect shortly after publication, but felt impact follows budgets, IRRs, and agency rollout - typically months, not days
what_you_can_do: Ask your municipal/barangay office or the implementing ministry how and when it will roll out where you live
Read the full text (PDF) on the Parliament's website or the Official Gazette of the Bangsamoro - the final sections say when it takes effect and who must act
If it isn't being implemented, raise it with your Member of Parliament or through the ministry's public assistance desk
watch_out_for: Already amended by BAA 37, 93, 94 - read the consolidated text

key_terms_explained.BAA: Bangsamoro Autonomy Act - a regional law passed by the Bangsamoro Parliament, applying inside BARMM alongside national laws.
key_terms_explained.IRR: Implementing Rules and Regulations - the ministry-issued 'how-to' that turns a law's text into procedures; many laws only bite once the IRR is out.
key_terms_explained.GAA: General Appropriations Act - the annual budget law deciding how much each ministry and program gets.

benefits.headline: Clearer government = claimable service standards.

direct_benefits.benefit: Know exactly which ministry owes you which service - the basis of every complaint and follow-up
direct_benefits.who_gets_it: Anyone transacting with the Bangsamoro Government
direct_benefits.how_to_access: Cite the ministry's mandate under the Administrative Code

direct_benefits.benefit: Appeal routes: decisions can be elevated along the chain the Code defines
direct_benefits.how_to_access: File with the office's next-level authority

indirect_benefits: A professional bureaucracy instead of ad-hoc offices
limitations: Benefits are procedural - the Code enables claims, it doesn't hand out programs
